entity_raw.definition_raw:
You can deftly defend yourself with makeshift weapons.

Prerequisite(s): Catch Off-Guard or Throw Anything, base attack bonus +1.

Benefit(s): You gain a +1 shield bonus to AC when you are wielding an improvised weapon and have your other hand free.
